text:
Alice: Quick sync — we need a firm decision on what's in the MVP for the next GA. ACME and a couple of trials are asking for per-tenant analytics and dedicated routing. Can we gate anything today? @Priya @Ben

Ben: My read — per-tenant analytics is big scope. High infra + UI effort. Recommend deferring to v1 unless legal/contract forces us.

Priya: Agree. We can ship lightweight telemetry (metrics + logs + basic traces) in MVP. Full per-tenant dashboards -> v1.

Margo: We do have the ACME pilot language in the contract. If we push analytics to v1 they will ask for a workaround.

Alice: Two options: (A) keep analytics and delay GA, (B) defer analytics and offer ACME a pilot preview on Dedicated under NDA. Option B keeps MVP momentum.

Dan: I can stand up a pilot on Dedicated. Need ACME staging creds and an ops runbook. ETA ~10 business days if nothing blocks.

Ben: Proposed cut list (for discussion):
- KEEP: hosted API, basic routing, KV caching, telemetry (lite), canary flag API, model catalog basics
- DEFER (v1): per-tenant analytics, advanced quantization UI, tenant-level billing, full rollout UI

Priya: Canary UI can be deferred but we should expose a simple flag+API for rollouts in MVP. That lets customers do manual canaries.

Alice: Agreed. Also need concrete GA acceptance criteria. My draft: 1) p99 latency <= 700ms for 512 tokens on standard workload, 2) security scan pass (Snyk + internal), 3) basic observability present in console, 4) no critical reliability regressions for 48h after canary.

Margo: Add: if a paid pilot customer requires a feature (like ACME), either we deliver pilot or remove them from GA commitments. We can't change contract without Sales alignment.

Ben: Also flag: dropping per-tenant billing now avoids complicated billing infra work. Recommend v1 for tenant billing.

Alice: Decision summary from this thread (we should record in the roadmap):
- Cut: per-tenant analytics, advanced quant UI, tenant billing (move to v1)
- Keep: canary-flag rollout API (no UI), basic telemetry, caching, routing
- ACME: offer pilot in Dedicated under NDA; pilot infra owned by Dan (ETA ~10 business days)
- Timeline: if pilot infra or ACME access delays >5 business days, expect GA slip +2w

Dan: I'll open the staging access request now and add the infra plan to the pilot doc.

Releases Bot: Deploy plan updated: release-window -> 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-13. Canary flag set to `beta` for rollout.

Emily: I'll update roadmap doc + the external customer comms template. Assigning tasks: Dan (pilot infra & staging creds), Ben (cut list PR + impacted tickets), Priya (rollout API spec), Alice (ACME comms and NDA note).

Alice: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll send a short note to Sales/Customer Success with the pilot offer and updated GA expectations. Quick follow-up call tomorrow 10:30 to confirm staging creds and final signoff.

Ben: Sounds good. I'll draft the cut PR tonight.

Priya: I'll drop the rollout API spec into the RFC doc and ping infra for a quick review.

Margo: I'll coordinate with Legal on the NDA language for the pilot.

Emily: Capturing action items in the roadmap tracker. Will flag the GA date as provisional until pilot signoff.

Alice: End of thread — thanks.
